name: Wintermute USDC Select
description: Wintermute USDC Select (armUSDCs) is a Morpho Vault V2 on Ethereum curated by Armitage by Wintermute. Armitage Select vaults consist of existing blue-chip high-TVL markets expanded by a few select higher-yield opportunities. It provides a higher yield compared to Prime while maintaining balanced risk exposure. Morpho Vaults are curated lending vaults that can allocate deposits to any number of Morpho protocols. Each vault is customizable and has a different risk profile. Curators are independent, third-party risk experts who use their expertise to offer various Morpho Vaults. The vault is also available through the Zama Protocol: Zama provides a confidentiality adapter that lets users deposit into the vault from confidential (encrypted-balance) tokens and hold their vault shares confidentially. Deposits made through Zama add to the TVL of this vault, so its share price needs to be available to wallets and integrators that rely on the CoinGecko API.
